title: Daily todo ledger
description: reports/<out>/daily/ledger.json: the record of which findings the daily run has filed on the todo list, kept by planTodos() in monitor/daily-todos.mjs and written by bin/daily-run.mjs. It, not the todo list, decides whether a finding is filed again: a todo the operator closed is not refiled while its finding persists. Finding ids are place-keyed and never include a line number.

configSha256.description: sha256 of the area's daily config the last run read; null before any run. A change makes the next comparison a baseline.

findings.description: Keyed by the daily digest's finding id: the first 16 hex characters of sha256(repo|category|rule|file).

todoId.description: The todo filed for the finding; null until one is.

closedByUser.description: The filed todo was closed or deleted while the finding persisted.

fixedBatch.description: The batch in which the finding was last reported fixed.

renamedTo.description: The finding's id after its file was renamed; its todo moved with it.
